<div id="dvResumeConfLayerMask" class="ACA_MaskDiv" style="height: 79px; z-index: 999;display:none;">
   
</div>

<div id="dvResumeConfirmation" class="ACA_Dialog Resume_Dialog">
    <div id="hidLink" tabindex="0"></div>
    <div class="Resume_Dialog_cont">
        <h1 class="ACA_Dialog_Title">
            <span id="ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_lblSaveResumePageFlowStep">Resume Application: Select Application Page Flow Step</span>
        </h1>
        <div class="ACA_Dialog_Close_Div">
            <a id="closeButton" href="#" title="Close" tabindex="0" onclick="ResumeConfirmationClose();return false;" class="NotShowLoading" onkeydown="OverrideTabKey(event, true, 'buttonCancel')">
                <img alt="Close" class="ACA_Dialog_Close_Image" src='/CitizenAccess/app_themes/Default/assets/closepopup.png'>
            </a>
        </div>
        <div class="ACA_MaskDiv ACA_Hide"></div>
        <div class="Resume_Dialog_Clear"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="ACA_Dialog_Content">
        <div class="Resume_Dialog_Row">
            <input type="radio" id="rdoResume" title="Start from the beginning" name="resumeOptionFromstart"  tabindex="0" value="start">
            <span id="ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_lblStartBeginning" onclick="$(&#39;#rdoResume&#39;).click()" class="ACA_New_Label font11px aca_checkbox aca_checkbox_fontsize">Start from the beginning</span>
        </div>
        <div class="Resume_Dialog_Row">
            <input type="radio" id="rdoStart" title="Pick up where I left off" name="resumeOptionFromWhereLeftOff" tabindex="0" value="resume">
            <span id="ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_lblPickUp" onclick="$(&#39;#rdoStart&#39;).click()" class="ACA_New_Label font11px aca_checkbox aca_checkbox_fontsize">Pick up where I left off</span>
        </div>
        <div class="Resume_Dialog_ButtonBar">
            <div class="ACA_LgButton ACA_LgButton_FontSize ACA_Button_Text">
                <a accesskey="3" href="#" title="OK" tabindex="0" onclick="ResumeConfirmationAction();return false;">
                    <span id="ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_linkOK">OK</span>
                </a>
                <a id="buttonCancel" accesskey="3" href="#" title="Close" class="Cancel_Button NotShowLoading" tabindex="0" onclick="ResumeConfirmationClose();return false;"  onkeydown="OverrideTabKey(event, false, 'closeButton')" >
                    <span id="ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_lblResumeCancel">Cancel</span>
                </a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script type="text/javascript">
   
    var _tmpelId = "";
    var hideResumeControlId = 'ctl00_PlaceHolderMain_dgvPermitList_inpHideResumeConf';

    function ResumeConfirmationClose() {
        $("#dvResumeConfLayerMask").hide();
        $("#dvResumeConfirmation").hide();

        var focusElementId = _tmpelId.replace(/\$/gi, "_");
        $("#" + focusElementId).focus();
    }

    
    function ResumeConfirmationAction() {        
        var selectedOption = $('input:radio[name*="resumeOption"]:checked').val();
        
        ProcessResume(selectedOption);
    }

    function ResumeConfirmation(element, clientID, isShowDialog) {
        ResetResumeConfig(clientID);
        _tmpelId = $(element).attr('id').replace(/_/gi, "$");

        //if isShowDialog flag is set to true, the dialog will be displaed
        if (isShowDialog == true) {
            $('input:radio[name*="resumeOption"]').prop('checked', false);

            $(document).on('click', 'input:radio[name*="resumeOption"]', function () {
                $('input:radio[name*="resumeOption"]').prop('checked', false);
                $(this).prop('checked', true);
            });

            $("#rdoStart").prop("checked", true);

            $("#dvResumeConfLayerMask").show().css("height", $("#ACAFrame").css("height") || "");
            
            var popupDialog = $("#dvResumeConfirmation");

            popupDialog.show();

            adjustPosition4PopupDialog(popupDialog);

            popupDialog.find('#hidLink').focus();
        }
        else {
            //do not show dialog and navigate user to the start of the pageflow
            ProcessResume('start');
        }
    }

    function ResetResumeConfig(clientID) {
        hideResumeControlId = "";
        // Get hideResumeControl's id based on the grid view control's client id
        var clientIDs = clientID.split("_");
        for (var i = 0; i < clientIDs.length - 1; i++) {
            hideResumeControlId += clientIDs[i] + "_";
        }
        hideResumeControlId += "inpHideResumeConf";

        // Reset its value
        var NeedReBind = document.getElementById(clientID);
        NeedReBind.value = "false";
    }

    //process resume either with dialog (from start or continue where left off) or without
    function ProcessResume(resumeOption) {
        if (resumeOption == 'start') {
            document.getElementById(hideResumeControlId).value = "false";
        } else {
            document.getElementById(hideResumeControlId).value = "true";
        }

        var p = new ProcessLoading();
        p.showLoading(false);
        ResumeConfirmationClose();
        __doPostBack(_tmpelId, '');
    }
</script>
